project_info.target_audience: Tech leaders, engineering directors, venture founders, and high-craft design agencies looking for a principal software engineer
project_info.design_freedom: HIGH - Awwwards Site-of-the-Day editorial aesthetic with strict color discipline

rules: Strict restriction to white/cream, black, and warm brown shades only.
NO vibrant neon or cold blue gradients. Brown is used deliberately for accents, line highlights, number tags, and micro-interactions.
Backgrounds must feel like textured parchment/cream paper (#FDFBF7), never pure clinical white (#FFFFFF) unless used as subtle inner contrast.

hierarchy.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-serif font-light tracking-tight leading-[1.05]
hierarchy.section_h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-serif font-normal tracking-tight text-[#111111]
hierarchy.chapter_num: font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-[#6E473B]
hierarchy.body_large: text-lg sm:text-xl font-sans font-light leading-relaxed text-[#524F4A]

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_mode: MODE A: Editorial Asymmetrical Grid (3:2 split, full width hero cards, vertical manifesto text)
spacing_and_layout.padding_rules: All bordered cards must have minimum p-6 sm:p-8 internal padding to ensure high breathability.

libraries: framer-motion (kinetic text reveals, scroll triggers, layout transitions)
lenis (smooth momentum scroll setup for luxury feel)
motion_and_effects.hero_animation: Line-by-line masked reveal with custom staggered delay (0.15s per line) on page mount.
motion_and_effects.parallax_effect: Interactive 3D geometry tilt canvas + mouse position parallax on hero sub-elements.

hero.subtext: Principal Full-Stack & Systems Engineer crafting high-performance distributed platforms, resilient APIs, and minimalist user interfaces.

chapters.heading: Simplicity is the Supreme Sophistication
chapters.body: Complex problems do not require convoluted abstractions. I build software where every class, module, and state boundary serves a single clear purpose with minimal cognitive overhead.

chapters.heading: Performant by Default, Unyielding by Design
chapters.body: Speed and reliability are non-negotiable feature requirements. Through type safety, optimized query structures, and deliberate memory hygiene, systems remain fast under heavy concurrency.

chapters.heading: The Intersection of Logic and Craft
chapters.body: Code is not merely instructions for machines; it is human communication. Software architecture should carry the exact same aesthetic discipline as mid-century Swiss typography.

dashboard.title: Inbound Message Command Center
dashboard.description: Built-in owner dashboard for viewing, organizing, and replying to client inquiries submitted via the contact form.
features: Live message table with search and filtering by engagement type
Mark messages as Read / Unread / Starred
Detailed modal view with raw payload view and mailto quick-reply
Backend persistence with FastAPI database endpoints

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire app enforces the warm cream (#FDFBF7), deep charcoal black (#111111), and rich brown accent (#6E473B / #8C5A4A) palette.
Do NOT introduce blue, purple, or neon gradients anywhere in the UI.
Ensure all interactive buttons, links, inputs, and message cards include kebab-case data-testid attributes.
Implement Lenis smooth momentum scrolling and framer-motion scroll entrance animations.
Ensure the contact form submits to the FastAPI backend at POST /api/contact and saves messages so the /dashboard route displays them dynamically.
